intro: For Sunday April 12, 2026, this article rounds up Wordle, Strands, and Connections in one scroll-friendly layout. Each block begins with soft clues and ends with optional reveals, so you can protect your streak without spoiling the fun up front.

hints: A common color surname and a cooking verb.
Double letters sit together in the middle.
Everything ties to how we think and remember.
The spangram is a long -ING word about mental effort.
strands.spangramHint: Gerund form of using your brain actively—not passive daydreaming.

faq.question: Is the FAQ different every day?
faq.answer: Yes—each dated post can include custom questions. If a file omits FAQ entries, sensible defaults are shown instead.

faq.question: Will these URLs work offline?
faq.answer: After the static site loads once, your browser may cache pages, but fresh hints require visiting the site online.

faq.question: How do I jump between games on this page?
faq.answer: Use your browser find feature or the table of contents implied by the H2 headings: Wordle, Strands, Connections, and FAQ.
